doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Higgins, Hendrix and the spiritual path
title: Hendrix down the street in Greenwich Village
summary: Lloyd places his Village building near the Cafe Wha, with Bobby Hutchinson as neighbor and Hendrix playing down the street before going to England.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well we started talking about Hendrix. And then we went from Hendrix to ping pong right?
Well we’re still by Hendrix, the ping pong was a metaphor.
The brownstone.
The brownstone.
I told you - I know! I’m over there at the brownstone. Come on, man!
Ok, I know!
Don’t go there. See, it’s in the now.
Well see, I’m trying to move in yours though, but then I go too far, right?
[Laughs]
You’re with me! Yeah, I know, but then... Well, but no you don’t have to go back, you can just say, “It was the brownstone. Brownstone, Lloyd! Over here Lloyd.”
I was trying to hear that thing like above the thirteenth of the chord.
I understand... which is just a sixth anyway.
Yeah! [Laughs]
What happened was that I had this place with all these...
Near the Cafe Wha? Was it?
Yeah.
You said it was near him?
He was down the street, yeah. I was up ­
Yeah, he was down the street. See, I got there!

I was up across the street - I was between Sullivan and Thompson. And on the corner of - it must have been Sullivan, cause Thompson was higher - So on the corner of Sullivan, Bobby Hutchinson lived in a building above the Carvel store, the ice cream store.
Uh-huh. Alright.
And he would always be in the window. He was my neighbor there. Anyway, I’m sorry I talk too loud, yeah.
No, it’s alright.

No, your brother has to attenuate the stuff. So the thing with Jimi - Jimi was down the street and I heard it. Then he went over to England but I heard cause I had played with Howlin’ Wolf and all them cats.
That’s why I asked you.
I knew where he was coming from but he was also a cadet with it.
Yeah.
